themes_detail.label: Dead Animal Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Dead animal complaints surged to 15 last week—a 1400% spike (vs. 1.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks)—suggesting a potential public health or pest control breakdown in CD 207 this week.
evidence: 15 dead animal complaints last week vs. 1.0 weekly average (8-week baseline)
Z-score of 14.0 indicates extreme statistical anomaly
No prior reporting or community board escalation documented
reporting_angles: Interview DSNY about outbreak cause—disease, rodent population surge, sanitation gap?
Map complaint locations to identify geographic hotspot (single block vs. district-wide)

themes_detail.label: Cannabis Retailer Violations
themes_detail.summary: Cannabis retailer complaints jumped to 7 last week—a 600% spike (vs. 1.0 weekly average)—suggesting unlicensed or non-compliant shops are proliferating in Kingsbridge/Bedford Park this week.
evidence: 7 cannabis retailer complaints last week vs. 1.0 weekly average (8-week baseline)
Z-score of 6.0 indicates significant statistical spike
No community board or constituent escalation yet; potential early warning signal
reporting_angles: Identify specific shop addresses and compliance violations (licensing, zoning, operation hours)
Interview OCCA and local enforcement about illegal vs. licensed retailer enforcement pace in CD 207

themes_detail.label: Traffic Congestion Spike
themes_detail.summary: Traffic complaints exploded to 3 last week—a 2300% spike (vs. 0.1 weekly average)—marking an unusual surge in street-level gridlock or access issues in Kingsbridge/Bedford Park this week.
evidence: 3 traffic complaints last week vs. 0.1 weekly average (8-week baseline)
Z-score of 8.69 indicates extreme statistical anomaly
Timing aligns with potential construction activity (344 DOB permits filed in 90 days)
reporting_angles: Cross-reference with active DOB projects and ULURP rezonings (Fordham Landing South, 2553 University Ave) for construction-related congestion
Identify specific streets/intersections and whether complaints cluster around development sites

themes_detail.label: Drinking & Street Behavior
themes_detail.summary: Public drinking complaints surged to 3 last week—a 700% spike (vs. 0.4 weekly average)—and panhandling complaints peaked at 6 three weeks ago (220% above baseline), suggesting emerging street disorder concerns across CD 207.
evidence: Drinking complaints: 3 last week vs. 0.4 weekly average (700% spike, z-score 5.42)
Panhandling complaints: 6 three weeks ago vs. 1.9 weekly average (220% spike, z-score 3.92)
Community board budget requests mention 'Other request for services for the homeless' (unmet recurring need)
reporting_angles: Interview local precinct and outreach teams on homeless population trends and street activity hotspots
Examine alignment with existing community board requests for homeless services expansion

themes_detail.label: Graffiti Uptick
themes_detail.summary: Graffiti complaints jumped to 4 last week—a 433% spike (vs. 0.8 weekly average)—indicating a sudden increase in street defacement activity in Kingsbridge/Bedford Park this week.
evidence: 4 graffiti complaints last week vs. 0.8 weekly average (8-week baseline)
Z-score of 4.91 indicates significant statistical anomaly
No corroborating community board or news reporting yet
reporting_angles: Map complaint locations to identify corridor or neighborhood cluster
Interview DSNY and local precinct on enforcement response and potential gang activity connection
